propositions: rebar must support encrypted S3 buckets (via git-remote-s3 helper) as an alternative ticket-store remote to GitHub, preserving git/event data format and auto-commit/auto-push flow
concurrent or legacy pushes to S3 can create multiple bundle files per ref, causing git ls-remote to return duplicate SHAs and hard-failing clone operations ('multiple updates for ref not allowed')
clients without the IfNoneMatch lock create the multi-bundle corruption state; missing or outdated git-remote-s3 helper must be detected and fail-closed during store init and push
multi-bundle state must self-heal non-interactively by merging all divergent heads under a repo-level repair lock, preserving all commits and events while collapsing to a single bundle per ref
optional S3 dependency (git-remote-s3>=0.3.2) and helper version gate must be declared in pyproject.toml with an availability guard and integrated into push and init code paths
